run_random_crop_cli: run the random crop script to generate image and flow patches from a dataset
run_crop_kitti_dataset: run the crop tool on the kitti2012 dataset with a specified number of crops
run_crop_with_custom_size: run the crop script with custom patch height and width arguments

review_crop_generation_loop: review the main loop that generates random crop patches from image pairs and flow files
